latest.title: Inflation has shoppers hunting for value. That bodes well for Black Friday
latest.description: Even as consumers face macroeconomic headwinds, retailers are expecting robust holiday spending through Black Friday and beyond.

latest.title: OpenAI Turns the Tables on Apple With Its Own Trade-Secret Theft Claims
latest.description: The ChatGPT maker’s counterclaims flip the script on a dispute Apple started in July, alleging the iPhone maker took its trade secrets and pressured shared hardware suppliers to freeze it out of the AI-device race.

latest.title: Franklin Templeton makes room for HYPE in crypto index ETF
latest.description: The addition comes as US spot investment products tracking Hyperliquid’s native token reach $266.5 million in assets under management.

latest.title: Could AI Break Bitcoin? Not Yet, Research Firm K33 Says
latest.description: A draft AI-assisted proof of the Riemann Hypothesis renewed worries about the math securing Bitcoin, but K33 says no cryptographic compromise has been demonstrated.

latest.title: 4 Scary Bitcoin Charts That Suggest This Bear Market Is Different
latest.description: Bitcoin is trading below several of its most popular long-term price models, breaking historical support levels that previously helped investors anticipate the cryptocurrency's eventual recovery from prolonged, painful bear markets.

latest.title: Bitcoin whales pile into BTC despite shrinking profit cushion
latest.description: CryptoQuant data shows Bitcoin whales are breaking with historical fourth-quarter selling patterns despite a market downturn.

latest.title: Jensen Huang's return did little to ease AI jitters. We used the weakness to buy
latest.description: Jensen Huang's return sparked a fleeting AI rally, but persistent market volatility gave us another opportunity to put cash to work.

latest.title: SpaceX shares jump over 4% amid tech rally and after Musk says he will expand on Trump Account share donations
latest.description: SpaceX shares jumped in trading Friday after Elon Musk said on X that he would donate shares to American children every year.

latest.title: Budget airline Norse Atlantic files for bankruptcy in Europe after failing to secure funding
latest.description: Budget carrier Norse Atlantic filed for bankruptcy Friday, saying it failed to secure funding after soaring fuel costs strained the company's operations.

latest.title: $7 Billion in Bitcoin Options Just Expired: Here’s What It Means
latest.description: Bitcoin’s largest options expiry this month comes as traders increasingly seek protection against further losses, with some hedging against a potential drop to $40,000 before the end of the year.

latest.title: Hackers Hit US Air Force Cloud System Running Air-Defense and Munitions Data
latest.description: The intrusion at Cloud One, discovered during a system upgrade, has prompted a Cyber Command damage assessment and disrupted the platform that runs air-defense radar feeds, munitions tracking and personnel data.

latest.title: China sets March 2027 rollout for blockchain identity regulations
latest.description: China has issued new regulations governing blockchain-based digital identities, setting rules for cross-platform verification and data privacy.

latest.title: Nvidia's Blackwell Chips Turn Up in China as Trump Floats Government Stake
latest.description: Banned Nvidia racks were found at a Shanghai data center tied to Alice Huang, as Trump said the U.S. could still take a stake in the firm.

latest.title: Bitcoin price drops below $59K as Anthropic joins tech stock rebound
latest.description: Bitcoin price volatility returned at the Wall Street open as BTC/USD dropped to local lows of $58,700 while stocks and gold headed higher.

latest.title: AI-Powered GTA 6 PC Ports Now Have Multiplayer as Modders Unlock 30 and 60 FPS
latest.description: Modders have added multiplayer to an unofficial PC port and unlocked higher frame rates on jailbroken consoles.

latest.title: It’s not just you: Durable goods are getting less reliable, from sputtering cars to glitching smart TVs
latest.description: A wide swath of consumer products are becoming less reliable and durable, even as their prices rise, research shows.

latest.title: Trump demands probe into 'record setting error' after third-quarter GDP data gets massive revision higher
latest.description: President Donald Trump on Thursday deemed the latest gross domestic product revision a mistake, claiming that it should be "immediately investigated."

latest.title: 'The Traitors' ended with a $246,300 prize—here's who won and what they told us about spending it
latest.description: Winning prize money can come with some big financial decisions, including how much to set aside for taxes.

latest.description: SAP is reportedly considering cutting 10,000 jobs as it reshapes its software business around AI.
